author: musho7-dev
subject: Add TIRES tab to TUNE: 5 tire styles for every car
body:
Original, Whitewall, Racing (+4% speed, -4% grip, rim in the car's
paint), Off-road (+6% grip, -3% speed, chunky treads), Neon (glowing
cyan rims) and Gold. Each car remembers its tires; they show in runs,
the garage and share pictures, and the speed/grip effects apply to the
physics and the stat bars. Bought once, usable on all cars, with
preview-before-buy like paint and decals.
